summary: Military aircraft must avoid an equestrian event within 2 nautical miles of Maidens, South Ayrshire, up to 2,000 feet above ground.
text:
MIL ACFT SHALL AVOID AN EQUESTRIAN EVENT WI 2NM RADIUS OF PSN 
551944N 0044924W (MAIDENS, SOUTH AYRSHIRE) LOW FLYING AREA 16. SFC 
TO 2000FT AGL. 26/11/080/LFC
